strikes.summary: Governor Drozdenko said two drones hit the Kaliningrad-bound ship west of Gogland on 21 November. It caught fire and drifted into Finnish waters off Loviisa, and the crew was evacuated. Finland's Defence Forces believe Ukraine was most likely responsible; Ukraine has not claimed it.

sources.title: Главные новости к этому часу: В Финском заливе БПЛА атаковали судно, следовавшее в Калининград (Top news: drones attacked a Kaliningrad-bound ship in the Gulf of Finland, translated)
Russia Says Cargo Vessel Struck by Drones in Gulf of Finland
Finland confirms Ukraine attacked ship linked to Russian military

strikes.target_name: Rosgvardiya Main Directorate for Krasnodar Krai, Krasnodar
strikes.summary: Monitoring channels and residents reported explosions in Krasnodar overnight into 22 November, and ASTRA's OSINT analysis named the regional Rosgvardiya headquarters as the likely target. Krasnodar airport paused flights. The Kyiv Independent could not verify the reports, and we found no Ukrainian or Russian official statement.

sources.title: Ukrainian drones reportedly strike Russian National Guard facility in Krasnodar

strikes.target_name: Russian Navy corvette Merkury, Benghazi port
strikes.weapon_detail: Seven naval drones from a mothership
strikes.damage: The corvette sank at its berth in Benghazi, leaving only the bow above water. SBU video and satellite imagery show the strike.
strikes.summary: Zelensky and the SBU confirmed that seven Ukrainian naval drones, launched from a mothership, sank the corvette Merkury in Benghazi on 22 November and hit the cargo ship MV Angara. Meduza, citing Al Jazeera sources, reports Russian and Libyan deaths. The Kremlin declined direct comment.

sources.title: Russian warship docked in Benghazi hit by suspected drone attack, Libyan officials say
Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
В результате новой атаки на судно в порту Бенгази есть пострадавшие (There are casualties after a new attack on a ship in Benghazi port, translated)
Ukraine confirms it used naval drones to strike two Russian ships off Libya
Ukrainian sea drones sink Russian warship in Libya, killing Russians and Libyans

strikes.summary: The SBU and HUR said drones hit the bitumen unit and a primary distillation column at the refinery overnight into 23 November. Ukraine's General Staff said the fire was visible from satellite. Meduza reported the strike; we opened no Russian official source.

sources.title: СБУ спільно з ГУР уразила Новошахтинський НПЗ у Ростовській області рф (The SBU and HUR struck the Novoshakhtinsk refinery in Rostov Oblast, translated)
Що горить на Новошахтинському НПЗ? (What is burning at the Novoshakhtinsk refinery?, translated)
Ukrainian drones strike two Russian oil refineries and pumping station in overnight attacks

strikes.target_name: Kaleykino oil pumping station, near Almetyevsk
strikes.summary: The SBU said its Alpha drones attacked the Kaleykino pumping station, more than 1,200 km from Ukraine, overnight into 23 November. It is the second strike on the site since 18 November. Meduza reported the attack; we opened no Russian official source.

sources.title: СБУ уразила нафтоперекачувальну станцію «Калейкино» в Татарстані (The SBU struck the Kaleykino oil pumping station in Tatarstan, translated)
Ukrainian drones strike two Russian oil refineries and pumping station in overnight attacks

strikes.summary: Ukraine's General Staff said it hit the refinery, more than 1,500 km from the border, on 23 November. The Moscow Times reports Governor Makhonin said drones targeted "several" facilities, killing one person and lightly injuring two. Astra placed the fires in the primary processing area.

sources.title: Сили оборони уразили НПЗ «Лукойлу» в Пермі за понад 1500 кілометрів від кордону (Defence Forces hit Lukoil's Perm refinery more than 1,500 km from the border, translated)
Ukrainian Drones Kill 1, Strike Oil Refinery in Perm Region

strikes.summary: Ukraine's General Staff claims hits on the AVT-4 and AVT-5 distillation units, a reformer and two tanks at the 7m-tonne refinery overnight into 25 November. Meduza reports Governor Fedorishchev confirmed an attack, one death and power outages, without naming the site.

sources.title: Самарський дубль: Сили оборони уразили Куйбишевський і Сизранський НПЗ (A Samara double: Defence Forces hit the Kuibyshev and Syzran refineries, translated)
Ukrainian drones strike Russia's Samara region, killing one and setting two Rosneft oil refineries ablaze

strikes.summary: Ukraine's General Staff claims preliminary damage to the AVT-6 distillation unit, reforming, hydrotreating and isomerisation units and two tanks overnight into 25 November. Meduza, citing monitoring channels, reports a fire at the refinery; we opened no Russian official source naming it.

sources.title: Самарський дубль: Сили оборони уразили Куйбишевський і Сизранський НПЗ (A Samara double: Defence Forces hit the Kuibyshev and Syzran refineries, translated)
Ukrainian drones strike Russia's Samara region, killing one and setting two Rosneft oil refineries ablaze

strikes.summary: Ukraine's General Staff claims strikes on 24–25 November hit three MiG-31s, which carry Kinzhal missiles, and two Su-34s at Savasleyka. It says the damage is still being clarified. We found no Russian official confirmation.

sources.title: 5 літаків, якими росіяни тероризують цивільних українців, уражено на аеродромі «Саваслейка» (Five aircraft used to terrorise Ukrainian civilians hit at Savasleyka airfield, translated)
